tagline.en: Taiwan's first road across the Central Mountain Range, cut by retired soldiers through Taroko Gorge
tagline.zh: 台湾第一条横越中央山脉的公路，由退役官兵凿穿太鲁阁峡谷

start.en: Dongshi bridge, Dongshi District, Taichung, on Provincial Highway 3
start.zh: 台中市东势区东势大桥，与台 3 线相会

end.en: Taroko bridge at Xintian, Xincheng, Hualien, on Provincial Highway 9
end.zh: 花莲县新城乡新田太鲁阁大桥，与台 9 线相会

en: Provincial Highway 8 crosses the Central Mountain Range from Dongshi in Taichung to Xincheng in Hualien, 187.8 km. It climbs the Dajia River valley past Guguan, Deji and Lishan, crosses the divide at Dayuling, 2,565 m, under the Hehuanshan tunnel, and drops down the Liwu River through Guanyuan, Tianxiang and Taroko Gorge to the east coast.

It is the trunk of a small system. The Yilan branch, Provincial Highway 7A, goes north from Lishan past Wuling farm to the Northern Cross-Island Highway; the Wushe branch, Provincial Highway 14A, comes up from Wushe past Qingjing and over Wuling to meet the main line at Dayuling.

It has not been a through road for most of its recent life. The 1999 earthquake wrecked the section between Guguan and Deji, and that piece is still closed to the public; travellers from the west reach the eastern half by Highways 14 and 14A instead.
zh: 台 8 线自台中东势至花莲新城，横越中央山脉，全长 187.8 公里。它沿大甲溪河谷上溯，经谷关、德基、梨山，在大禹岭（海拔 2,565 米）以合欢山隧道越过分水岭，再沿立雾溪经关原、天祥与太鲁阁峡谷下到东海岸。
它是一个小路网的主干：宜兰支线台 7 甲线自梨山北行，经武陵农场接北部横贯公路；雾社支线台 14 甲线自雾社上行，经清境、越武岭，在大禹岭与主线相接。
近年来它大部分时间都不是一条贯通的路。1999 年地震摧毁了谷关至德基一段，至今仍不对一般大众开放；从西部来的旅客改走台 14 线与台 14 甲线前往东段。

en: The road was cut largely by hand. The workers' main tools were picks and explosives, and many were injured by blasting. The hardest stretch was the 20 km from Taroko to Tianxiang, where the road had to be carried along cliffs of hard marble; that is why the gorge section is so dense with tunnels and bridges, and why they became the road's sights.

The Swallow Grotto (Yanzikou) and the Tunnel of Nine Turns (Jiuqudong) are both in the gorge. Jiuqudong has since been bypassed by a two-lane tunnel, and the old road kept as a walking route. At Bilü, near the 123 km mark, a cliff was named the Cliff of the Foolish Old Man by Chiang Ching-kuo after the road opened, in honour of the men who died cutting it.

Between Guguan and Deji the road originally had two lines: the upper Qingshan line on Highway 8 and the lower Qingshan line, Highway 8A. After 1999 the upper line was abandoned. The repaired lower line is now the restricted temporary road, numbered Highway 8 Lin 37.
zh: 这条路大体是靠人力凿出来的。开路工人最主要的工具是十字镐与炸药，因炸药控制不当而受伤的工人不少。最艰难的是太鲁阁至天祥那 20 公里，道路须沿坚硬的大理石峭壁开凿，桥梁与隧道特别多，后来也成了中横最主要的景观。
燕子口与九曲洞都在峡谷段。九曲洞旁后来开凿了双线隧道，旧路改为步行景观道路。碧绿附近 123 公里处的峭壁，中横通车后由蒋经国命名为「愚公峭壁」，以纪念开路牺牲的人。
谷关至德基之间原有两条路线：台 8 线的青山上线与台 8 甲线的青山下线。1999 年后上线被放弃，修复后的下线即现今管制通行的台 8 线临 37 便道。

en: The eastern route began as a hunting trail of the Truku people up the Liwu gorge. After the Truku War of 1914 the Japanese built a police trail on it, finished in 1935 as the Hehuan crossing road from Wushe over Hehuanshan to Taroko; parts were widened for motor traffic from 1940 to reach gold and power sites, and the work stopped with the war.

In 1954 engineers from the American consulting firm White, led by V. S. de Beausset, surveyed the line and fixed the route used today, Taichung to Hualien by Lishan and the Liwu River. The road became part of the United States' 1955 military aid programme for military roads, and American aid paid about four-fifths of the cost and supplied key engineers, machinery and steel.

The labour came from the army. Chiang Ching-kuo, who headed the Vocational Assistance Commission for Retired Servicemen, walked the line himself in 1955 and again in June 1956. Ground was broken at both ends on 7 July 1956, with the premier, O. K. Yui, presiding, and more than 10,000 retired servicemen were put to work. Chiang gave three aims: a route across the mountains for defence, access to the mountains' resources, and jobs for retired soldiers — many of whom were afterwards settled on farms along the road, at Fushoushan, Wuling, Qingjing, Xibao and elsewhere.

It cost lives. The first death came in October 1957, when the engineer Jin Heng was knocked into the gorge by rockfall in an earthquake; by the end 212 people had died and 702 were injured, more than one for each kilometre. The Eternal Spring Shrine above the gorge honours them. The road opened on 9 May 1960, half a year early, after three years, nine months and eighteen days; the vice-president, Chen Cheng, presided.

On 21 September 1999 the Jiji earthquake, centred close by, brought down more than 80 per cent of the slopes between Guguan and Deji; the roadbed was lost entirely in 26 places. A repaired road was due to reopen in July 2004, but Typhoon Mindulle's floods that month destroyed more than NT$2 billion of new work. A government hearing then decided to leave the valley to recover, which brought protests from the 2,000 or so people of Lishan, who were left with a four-hour detour.

The temporary road was finished for residents and workers. Since 16 November 2018 a Taichung city bus, route 865, has run from Guguan to Lishan, but other vehicles still may not use it. In 2023 the transport ministry chose to rebuild on the lower Qingshan line, and on 17 February 2024 the Executive Yuan approved the feasibility study for rebuilding the 36–62 km section. The Hualien earthquake of 3 April 2024 then damaged the eastern half in many places.
zh: 东段路线起初是太鲁阁族人沿立雾溪峡谷的狩猎道。1914 年太鲁阁战争后，日人在其上开辟理蕃步道，1935 年完成自雾社经合欢山至太鲁阁的「合欢越岭道路」；1940 年起为开发金矿与水力，局部拓宽为汽车道，战争结束时停工。
1954 年，美国怀特顾问公司经理狄宝赛（V. S. de Beausset）等人踏勘，确定了今天的路线：自台中经梨山，沿立雾溪而下至花莲。中横被纳入美国「1955 年度军援军用道路计划」，美援提供约八成工程经费，以及关键技术人员、机具与钢材。
人力则来自军队。时任退除役官兵就业辅导委员会主任委员的蒋经国，1955 年与 1956 年 6 月两度亲自率队踏勘。1956 年 7 月 7 日，东西两端同时举行开工典礼，由行政院长俞鸿钧主持，动员退伍荣民一万多人。蒋经国提出三项目的：为国防打通中央山脉、开发山区资源、安置退除役官兵——许多荣民后来就在沿线的福寿山、武陵、清境、西宝等地农场安家。
这条路付出了人命。第一起死亡发生在 1957 年 10 月，工程师靳珩在地震中被落石击中，坠落山谷；统计因工程意外及天灾殉难者 212 人、受伤 702 人，平均每公里牺牲一人有余。峡谷上方的长春祠供奉殉职人员。1960 年 5 月 9 日通车，比预定提早半年，工期三年九个月十八天，由副总统陈诚主持通车典礼。
1999 年 9 月 21 日，震中邻近的集集大地震使谷关至德基一带边坡崩塌达八成以上，路基全部流失处多达 26 处。修复后的道路原定 2004 年 7 月开放，但当月敏督利台风引发的七二水灾使花了二十多亿元刚修好的路段再度大量崩塌。随后召开的听证会决议暂不复建，让山林休养，引起梨山两千多位居民抗议——他们出入须绕道四个小时。
便道其后修整完成，供居民及工作人员通行。2018 年 11 月 16 日起，台中市公车 865 路行驶谷关至梨山，但其他车辆仍不得通行。2023 年交通部决定采青山下线方案复建；2024 年 2 月 17 日，行政院通过台 8 线 36K 至 62K 谷关至德基段复建可行性研究。同年 4 月 3 日的花莲地震又使东段多处受损。

en: The construction cost about NT$494.56 million, of which NT$389.94 million was American aid. Planning brought together the US aid council, the Joint Commission on Rural Reconstruction, the economics ministry and provincial departments; because the labour came from the retired servicemen's commission, it was given the lead.

After 1999 repair money became a political question. The highways directorate budgeted NT$620 million for an emergency road in 2009–2010, which the legislature cut; by 2020 it had put about NT$4 billion into making the temporary road safer.
zh: 工程费约新台币 4 亿 9,456 万元，其中美援 3 亿 8,994 万元。规划时曾集合美援运用委员会、中国农村复兴联合委员会、经济部及省府各厅处共商；因开凿人力主要来自退辅会，最后由退辅会主导。
1999 年后，修路的钱成了政治问题。公路总局为 2009、2010 年编列新台币 6 亿 2,000 万元抢通便道，遭立法院删除；至 2020 年，公路总局已投入约 40 亿元提升临 37 便道的安全性。

en: Limits are 10 to 60 km/h. The road through Taroko is narrow, and cyclists share it with motor traffic; the temporary road above Guguan is prone to rockfall and slips. Between Guguan and Deji only the 865 bus, residents and workers with permits may pass; to cross from the west by car, use Highway 14 to Wushe and Highway 14A over Wuling to Dayuling.
The worst crash on Taiwan's roads happened here: in 1986 a tour coach went into the river near Guguan and 42 people died.
zh: 速限为每小时 10 至 60 公里。太鲁阁路段路窄，自行车与机动车辆同行；谷关以上的便道地质不稳，极易落石坍方。谷关至德基之间只有 865 路公车及持通行证的居民与工作人员可通行；自西部开车往东，须走台 14 线至雾社，再经台 14 甲线越武岭至大禹岭。
台湾公路死亡人数最多的事故就发生在这条路上：1986 年一辆游览车在谷关附近坠河，42 人罹难。

timeline.en: The Japanese finish the Hehuan crossing trail from Wushe to Taroko.
timeline.zh: 日人完成自雾社至太鲁阁的合欢越岭道路。

timeline.en: American consultants survey and fix the route.
timeline.zh: 美国怀特顾问公司踏勘并确定路线。

timeline.en: Ground is broken at both ends on 7 July; more than 10,000 retired servicemen are put to work.
timeline.zh: 7 月 7 日东西两端同时开工，动员退伍荣民一万多人。

timeline.en: The engineer Jin Heng is killed by rockfall in October, the first death on the job.
timeline.zh: 10 月，工程师靳珩遭地震落石击落山谷，为第一位殉职者。

timeline.en: The road opens on 9 May, half a year ahead of schedule.
timeline.zh: 5 月 9 日通车，比预定提早半年。

timeline.en: A tour coach goes into the river near Guguan; 42 die.
timeline.zh: 游览车在谷关坠河，42 人罹难。

timeline.en: The Jiji earthquake on 21 September wrecks the Guguan–Deji section.
timeline.zh: 9 月 21 日集集大地震重创谷关至德基路段。

timeline.en: Typhoon Mindulle's floods in July destroy the repairs; rebuilding is shelved.
timeline.zh: 7 月敏督利台风引发七二水灾，修复路段再度崩毁，复建暂缓。

timeline.en: Bus 865 begins running from Guguan to Lishan on 16 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 16 日，865 路公车开始行驶谷关至梨山。

timeline.en: The Executive Yuan approves the rebuilding feasibility study on 17 February; the 3 April Hualien earthquake damages the eastern half.
timeline.zh: 2 月 17 日行政院通过复建可行性研究；4 月 3 日花莲地震造成东段多处受损。
